name: Always On
description: A few decibels over unity, left on: a little more level and sparkle into the amplifier.

name: Hot Stage
description: Full up with the output turned down: the transistor's own lopsided clipping, heard at a sensible level.

name: Push the Amp
description: Full up: the stage starts to flatten on hard notes, and the amplifier after it breaks up sooner.

name: Solo Lift
description: Some 12 dB up for a solo, still clean on a guitar played normally.
